title: Windows Server - Detail

targets.rawSql:
WITH x AS (
  SELECT h.DisplayName AS comp, r.ObjectName AS o, r.CounterName AS c, i.InstanceName AS inst, AVG(p.SampleValue) AS v, MAX(p.DateTime) AS last_t
  FROM Perf.vPerfRaw p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE p.DateTime > DATEADD(minute, -60, GETUTCDATE())
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote})
    AND ( (r.ObjectName = 'Processor Information' AND r.CounterName = '% Processor Time' AND i.InstanceName = '_Total')
       OR (r.ObjectName = 'Memory' AND r.CounterName = 'PercentMemoryUsed')
       OR (r.ObjectName = 'LogicalDisk' AND r.CounterName = '% Free Space') )
  GROUP BY h.DisplayName, r.ObjectName, r.CounterName, i.InstanceName
)
SELECT comp AS Computer,
  MAX(CASE WHEN o = 'Processor Information' THEN v END) AS "CPU %",
  MAX(CASE WHEN o = 'Memory' THEN v END) AS "Memory %",
  MIN(CASE WHEN o = 'LogicalDisk' THEN v END) AS "Lowest disk free %",
  MAX(last_t) AS "Last sample (UTC)"
FROM x GROUP BY comp ORDER BY comp

SELECT TOP 500
  g.DisplayName AS Computer,
  CASE g.HealthState WHEN 1 THEN 'Healthy' WHEN 2 THEN 'Warning' WHEN 3 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Not monitored' END AS Health,
  g.StateLastModified AS LastStateChange,
  CASE WHEN g.InMaintenanceMode = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS InMaintenance,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT al.AlertId AS Id, al.AlertName AS Name, al.AlertDescription AS Description, al.BaseManagedEntityId AS MonitoringObjectId, bm.DisplayName AS MonitoringObjectDisplayName, bm.FullName AS MonitoringObjectFullName, bm.Path AS MonitoringObjectPath, bm.TopLevelHostEntityId AS TopLevelHostEntityId, al.IsMonitorAlert, al.RuleId AS MonitoringRuleId, al.ResolutionState, al.Priority, al.Severity, al.Category, al.Owner, al.ResolvedBy, al.TimeRaised, al.LastModified, al.TimeResolved, al.RepeatCount, al.TicketId, al.Context, al.AlertParams, al.CustomField1, al.CustomField2, al.CustomField3, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringName, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 2 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringDescription FROM dbo.Alert al JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity bm ON bm.BaseManagedEntityId = al.BaseManagedEntityId) a WHERE a.ResolutionState < 255 AND a.TopLevelHostEntityId = g.Id) AS OpenAlerts
FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.Computer')
  AND g.IsDeleted = 0
  AND g.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote})
ORDER BY CASE g.HealthState WHEN 3 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN 1 WHEN 1 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END, g.DisplayName

panels.description: Open alerts raised in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 300
  CASE a.Severity WHEN 2 THEN 'Critical' WHEN 1 THEN 'Warning' ELSE 'Information' END AS Severity,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(a.AlertStringName,''), a.Name) AS Alert,
  CAST(a.Id AS varchar(36)) AS AlertId,
  a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName AS Source,
  (SELECT TOP 1 c.DisplayName FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView c WHERE c.Id = a.TopLevelHostEntityId) AS Computer,
  CASE a.ResolutionState WHEN 0 THEN 'New' ELSE 'Acknowledged/Custom' END AS Status,
  a.RepeatCount AS Repeats,
  a.TimeRaised AS Raised
FROM (SELECT al.AlertId AS Id, al.AlertName AS Name, al.AlertDescription AS Description, al.BaseManagedEntityId AS MonitoringObjectId, bm.DisplayName AS MonitoringObjectDisplayName, bm.FullName AS MonitoringObjectFullName, bm.Path AS MonitoringObjectPath, bm.TopLevelHostEntityId AS TopLevelHostEntityId, al.IsMonitorAlert, al.RuleId AS MonitoringRuleId, al.ResolutionState, al.Priority, al.Severity, al.Category, al.Owner, al.ResolvedBy, al.TimeRaised, al.LastModified, al.TimeResolved, al.RepeatCount, al.TicketId, al.Context, al.AlertParams, al.CustomField1, al.CustomField2, al.CustomField3, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringName, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 2 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringDescription FROM dbo.Alert al JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity bm ON bm.BaseManagedEntityId = al.BaseManagedEntityId) a
WHERE a.ResolutionState < 255
  AND a.TimeRaised BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND ( a.TopLevelHostEntityId IN (SELECT c.Id FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView c WHERE c.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote}))
        OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView c WHERE c.Id = a.TopLevelHostEntityId AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = c.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.Computer')) )
ORDER BY a.Severity DESC, a.TimeRaised DESC

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 300
  CASE s.HealthState WHEN 3 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Warning' END AS Health,
  COALESCE((SELECT TOP 1 m.DisplayName FROM dbo.MonitorView m WHERE m.Id = s.MonitorId AND m.DisplayName IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.LanguageCode), s.MonitorName) AS Monitor,
  e.DisplayName AS Object,
  COALESCE(e.Path, e.DisplayName) AS Computer,
  s.LastModified AS Since
FROM dbo.StateView s
JOIN dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView e ON e.Id = s.BaseManagedEntityId
WHERE s.HealthState IN (2, 3)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.MonitorView m WHERE m.Id = s.MonitorId AND m.IsUnitMonitor = 1)
  AND e.IsDeleted = 0
  AND (e.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote}) OR e.Path IN (${server:singlequote}))
ORDER BY s.HealthState DESC, s.LastModified DESC

SELECT time, metric, value FROM (
  SELECT DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0) AS time, h.DisplayName AS metric, AVG(p.SampleValue) AS value
  FROM Perf.vPerfRaw p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 2880
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND r.ObjectName = 'Processor Information' AND r.CounterName = '% Processor Time'
    AND (i.InstanceName IN ('_Total','') OR '_Total' = '*')
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote})
  GROUP BY DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0), h.DisplayName
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.DateTime, h.DisplayName, AVG(p.AverageValue)
  FROM Perf.vPerfHourly p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE (DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) > 2880 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Perf.vPerfRaw x WHERE x.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()))
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND r.ObjectName = 'Processor Information' AND r.CounterName = '% Processor Time'
    AND (i.InstanceName IN ('_Total','') OR '_Total' = '*')
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote})
  GROUP BY p.DateTime, h.DisplayName
) x ORDER BY time

SELECT time, metric, value FROM (
  SELECT DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0) AS time,
         h.DisplayName + CASE WHEN i.InstanceName IN ('', '_Total') THEN '' ELSE ' [' + i.InstanceName + ']' END AS metric,
         AVG(p.SampleValue) * 1 AS value
  FROM Perf.vPerfRaw p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 2880
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND r.ObjectName = 'System' AND r.CounterName = 'Processor Queue Length'
    AND (i.InstanceName IN ('_Total', '') OR '_Total' = '*')
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote})
  GROUP BY DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0), h.DisplayName, i.InstanceName
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.DateTime,
         h.DisplayName + CASE WHEN i.InstanceName IN ('', '_Total') THEN '' ELSE ' [' + i.InstanceName + ']' END,
         AVG(p.AverageValue) * 1
  FROM Perf.vPerfHourly p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE (DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) > 2880 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Perf.vPerfRaw x WHERE x.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()))
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND r.ObjectName = 'System' AND r.CounterName = 'Processor Queue Length'
    AND (i.InstanceName IN ('_Total', '') OR '_Total' = '*')
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote})
  GROUP BY p.DateTime, h.DisplayName, i.InstanceName
) x ORDER BY time

SELECT TOP 300
  h.DisplayName AS Computer,
  i.InstanceName AS Disk,
  AVG(CASE WHEN r.CounterName = '% Free Space' THEN p.SampleValue END) AS "Free %",
  AVG(CASE WHEN r.CounterName = 'Free Megabytes' THEN p.SampleValue END) / 1024.0 AS "Free GB"
FROM Perf.vPerfRaw p
JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
WHERE p.DateTime > DATEADD(minute, -60, GETUTCDATE())
  AND r.ObjectName = 'LogicalDisk' AND r.CounterName IN ('% Free Space', 'Free Megabytes')
  AND h.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote})
GROUP BY h.DisplayName, i.InstanceName
HAVING AVG(CASE WHEN r.CounterName = '% Free Space' THEN p.SampleValue END) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 3, 1, 2

SELECT time, metric, value FROM (
  SELECT DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0) AS time,
         h.DisplayName + CASE WHEN i.InstanceName IN ('', '_Total') THEN '' ELSE ' [' + i.InstanceName + ']' END AS metric,
         AVG(p.SampleValue) * 1000 AS value
  FROM Perf.vPerfRaw p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 2880
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND r.ObjectName = 'LogicalDisk' AND r.CounterName = 'Avg. Disk sec/Transfer'
    AND (i.InstanceName IN ('_Total', '') OR '*' = '*')
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote})
  GROUP BY DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0), h.DisplayName, i.InstanceName
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.DateTime,
         h.DisplayName + CASE WHEN i.InstanceName IN ('', '_Total') THEN '' ELSE ' [' + i.InstanceName + ']' END,
         AVG(p.AverageValue) * 1000
  FROM Perf.vPerfHourly p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE (DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) > 2880 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Perf.vPerfRaw x WHERE x.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()))
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE (DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) > 2880 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Perf.vPerfRaw x WHERE x.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()))
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND r.ObjectName = 'Network Adapter' AND r.CounterName = 'Bytes Total/sec'
    AND (i.InstanceName IN ('_Total', '') OR '*' = '*')
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote})
  GROUP BY p.DateTime, h.DisplayName, i.InstanceName
) x ORDER BY time
